    """Get the timeline thumbnails size."""

def getTimelineWaveformSize(thumbnailSize: TimelineThumbnailSize) -> int:
    """Get the timeline waveform size."""

class TimelineSettings:
    """Timeline settings."""
    def __init__(self) -> None: ...

    @property
    def minimize(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the timeline shows only the first video and audio track:
        Timeline > Minimize.
        """

    @minimize.setter
    def minimize(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def frameView(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the timeline is zoomed to show the whole of it: Timeline >
        Frame View. Panning the timeline turns it off.
        """

    @frameView.setter
    def frameView(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def scrollBars(self) -> bool:
        """Whether a zoomed timeline has scroll bars: Timeline > Scroll Bars.
        """

    @scrollBars.setter
    def scrollBars(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def compareTimelines(self) -> bool:
        """The timeline of each file being compared, under the current file's.
        """

    @compareTimelines.setter
    def compareTimelines(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def autoScroll(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the timeline scrolls to keep the current frame in sight
        while playing: Timeline > Auto Scroll.
        """

    @autoScroll.setter
    def autoScroll(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def stopOnScrub(self) -> bool:
        """Whether scrubbing stops playback, rather than pausing it while the
        button is held: Timeline > Stop Playback When Scrubbing.
        """

    @stopOnScrub.setter
    def stopOnScrub(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def preview(self) -> bool:
        """A preview of the frame under the cursor."""

    @preview.setter
    def preview(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def trackMedia(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the video thumbnails and audio waveforms are shown at all:
        Timeline > Track Media.
        """

    @trackMedia.setter
    def trackMedia(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def thumbnails(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the video thumbnails are shown, with track media on:
        Timeline > Video Thumbnails.
        """

    @thumbnails.setter
    def thumbnails(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def thumbnailSize(self) -> TimelineThumbnailSize:
        """The height of the video thumbnails: Timeline > Video Thumbnail Size.
        """

    @thumbnailSize.setter
    def thumbnailSize(self, arg: TimelineThumbnailSize, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def waveforms(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the audio waveforms are shown, with track media on: Timeline
        > Audio Waveforms.
        """

    @waveforms.setter
    def waveforms(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def waveformSize(self) -> TimelineThumbnailSize:
        """The height of the audio waveforms: Timeline > Audio Waveform Size.
        """

    @waveformSize.setter
    def waveformSize(self, arg: TimelineThumbnailSize, /) -> None: ...

    def __eq__(self, arg: TimelineSettings, /) -> bool: ...

    def __ne__(self, arg: TimelineSettings, /) -> bool: ...

class WindowSettings:
    """Window settings."""
    def __init__(self) -> None: ...

    @property
    def size(self) -> feather_tk._feather_tk.Size2I:
        """The size the window has when it is not maximized."""

    @size.setter
    def size(self, arg: feather_tk._feather_tk.Size2I, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def pos(self) -> feather_tk._feather_tk.V2I:
        """Where the window was, once it has been somewhere: until then the
        platform places it.
        """

    @pos.setter
    def pos(self, arg: feather_tk._feather_tk.V2I, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def hasPos(self) -> bool:
        """Whether there is a position to put the window at."""

    @hasPos.setter
    def hasPos(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def maximized(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the window is maximized. The position, size and maximized
        state are applied when the main window is made, and saved from it.
        """

    @maximized.setter
    def maximized(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def fileToolBar(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the file tool bar is shown: Window > File Tool Bar."""

    @fileToolBar.setter
    def fileToolBar(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def compareToolBar(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the compare tool bar is shown: Window > Compare Tool Bar."""

    @compareToolBar.setter
    def compareToolBar(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def windowToolBar(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the window tool bar is shown: Window > Window Tool Bar."""

    @windowToolBar.setter
    def windowToolBar(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def viewToolBar(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the view tool bar is shown: Window > View Tool Bar."""

    @viewToolBar.setter
    def viewToolBar(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def toolsToolBar(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the tools tool bar is shown: Window > Tools Tool Bar."""

    @toolsToolBar.setter
    def toolsToolBar(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def tabBar(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the tab bar is shown: Window > Tab Bar."""

    @tabBar.setter
    def tabBar(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def timeline(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the timeline is shown, when a file is open: Window >
        Timeline.
        """

    @timeline.setter
    def timeline(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def bottomToolBar(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the bottom tool bar is shown: Window > Bottom Tool Bar."""

    @bottomToolBar.setter
    def bottomToolBar(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def statusToolBar(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the status bar is shown: Window > Status Tool Bar."""

    @statusToolBar.setter
    def statusToolBar(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def tools(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the tools panel is shown, when a tool is open: Window >
        Tools.
        """

    @tools.setter
    def tools(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def splitter(self) -> float:
        """The share of the height the view has above the timeline, from zero
        to one. The splitters are applied when the main window is made.
        """

    @splitter.setter
    def splitter(self, arg: float, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def splitter2(self) -> float:
        """The share of the width the view has beside the tools panel, from
        zero to one.
        """

    @splitter2.setter
    def splitter2(self, arg: float, /) -> None: ...

    def __eq__(self, arg: WindowSettings, /) -> bool: ...

    def __ne__(self, arg: WindowSettings, /) -> bool: ...

class AudioSettingsObserver:
    """Value observer."""
    def __init__(self, observable: IObservableAudioSettings, callback: Callable[[AudioSettings], None], action: feather_tk._feather_tk.ObserverAction = feather_tk._feather_tk.ObserverAction.Trigger) -> None: ...

class IObservableAudioSettings:
    """Base class for observable values."""
    def get(self) -> AudioSettings:
        """Get the value."""

    def getObserversCount(self) -> int:
        """Get the number of observers."""

class ObservableAudioSettings(IObservableAudioSettings):
    """Observable value."""
    def __init__(self, arg: AudioSettings, /) -> None: ...

    def setAlways(self, arg: AudioSettings, /) -> None:
        """Set the value."""

    def setIfChanged(self, arg: AudioSettings, /) -> bool:
        """Set the value only if it has changed."""

    def get(self) -> AudioSettings:
        """Get the value."""

    def setIfChanged(self, arg: WindowSettings, /) -> bool:
        """Set the value only if it has changed."""

    def get(self) -> WindowSettings:
        """Get the value."""

class SettingsModel:
    """Settings model."""
    def __init__(self, context: feather_tk._feather_tk.Context, settings: feather_tk._feather_tk.Settings) -> None:
        """Create a new model."""

    def save(self) -> None:
        """Save the settings. Settings are also saved on exit."""

    def reset(self) -> None:
        """Reset to default values."""

    @property
    def audio(self) -> AudioSettings:
        """Get the audio settings."""

    @audio.setter
    def audio(self, arg: AudioSettings, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeAudio(self) -> IObservableAudioSettings:
        """Observe the audio settings."""

    @property
    def cache(self) -> tlrender._tlrender.PlayerCacheOptions:
        """Get the cache settings: the sizes of the video and audio caches, in
        gigabytes, and how much is read behind the current frame. Sizes above
        getMaxCacheGB() are lowered to it when the settings are read.
        """

    @cache.setter
    def cache(self, arg: tlrender._tlrender.PlayerCacheOptions, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeCache(self) -> tlrender._tlrender.IObservablePlayerCacheOptions:
        """Observe the cache settings."""

    @property
    def export(self) -> ExportSettings:
        """Get the export settings."""

    @export.setter
    def export(self, arg: ExportSettings, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeExport(self) -> IObservableExportSettings:
        """Observe the export settings."""

    @property
    def fileBrowser(self) -> FileBrowserSettings:
        """Get the file browser settings."""

    @fileBrowser.setter
    def fileBrowser(self, arg: FileBrowserSettings, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeFileBrowser(self) -> IObservableFileBrowserSettings:
        """Observe the file browser settings."""

    @property
    def imageSeq(self) -> ImageSeqSettings:
        """Get the image sequence settings. They are taken when a file is
        opened.
        """

    @imageSeq.setter
    def imageSeq(self, arg: ImageSeqSettings, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeImageSeq(self) -> IObservableImageSeqSettings:
        """Observe the image sequence settings."""

    @property
    def otio(self) -> OTIOSettings:
        """Get the OTIO settings. They are taken when a file is opened."""

    @otio.setter
    def otio(self, arg: OTIOSettings, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeOTIO(self) -> IObservableOTIOSettings:
        """Observe the OTIO settings."""

    @property
    def misc(self) -> MiscSettings:
        """Get the miscellaneous settings."""

    @misc.setter
    def misc(self, arg: MiscSettings, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeMisc(self) -> IObservableMiscSettings:
        """Observe the miscellaneous settings."""

    @property
    def mouse(self) -> MouseSettings:
        """Get the mouse settings."""

    @mouse.setter
    def mouse(self, arg: MouseSettings, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeMouse(self) -> IObservableMouseSettings:
        """Observe the mouse settings."""

    @property
    def playback(self) -> PlaybackSettings:
        """Get the playback settings."""

    @playback.setter
    def playback(self, arg: PlaybackSettings, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observePlayback(self) -> IObservablePlaybackSettings:
        """Observe the playback settings."""

    @property
    def shortcuts(self) -> ShortcutsSettings:
        """Get the keyboard shortcuts settings."""

    @shortcuts.setter
    def shortcuts(self, arg: ShortcutsSettings, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeShortcuts(self) -> IObservableShortcutsSettings:
        """Observe the keyboard shortcuts settings."""

    def addShortcuts(self, shortcuts: Sequence[Shortcut]) -> None:
        """Add keyboard shortcuts. Any saved key bindings are applied to the
        added shortcuts.
        """

    @property
    def style(self) -> StyleSettings:
        """Get the style settings."""

    @style.setter
    def style(self, arg: StyleSettings, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeStyle(self) -> IObservableStyleSettings:
        """Observe the style settings."""

    @property
    def timeline(self) -> TimelineSettings:
        """Get the timeline settings."""

    @timeline.setter
    def timeline(self, arg: TimelineSettings, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeTimeline(self) -> IObservableTimelineSettings:
        """Observe the timeline settings."""

    @property
    def window(self) -> WindowSettings:
        """Get the window settings."""

    @window.setter
    def window(self, arg: WindowSettings, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeWindow(self) -> IObservableWindowSettings:
        """Observe the window settings."""

    @property
    def ioOptions(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Observe the I/O options: the image sequence, FFmpeg and USD settings
        together, as they are given to what reads files.
        """

    @property
    def observeIOOptions(self) -> feather_tk._feather_tk.IObservableStringMap:
        """Observe the I/O options: the image sequence, FFmpeg and USD settings
        together, as they are given to what reads files.
        """

class Shortcut:
    """Keyboard shortcuts."""
    @overload
    def __init__(self) -> None: ...

    @overload
    def __init__(self, name: str, text: str, primary: feather_tk._feather_tk.KeyShortcut = ..., secondary: feather_tk._feather_tk.KeyShortcut = ...) -> None: ...

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        """The name of the action, its group and its own: "Playback/Toggle"."""

    @name.setter
    def name(self, arg: str, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def text(self) -> str:
        """The action's label, as the keyboard shortcuts settings show it."""

    @text.setter
    def text(self, arg: str, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def primary(self) -> feather_tk._feather_tk.KeyShortcut:
        """The primary shortcut; a key of Unknown is none."""

    @primary.setter
    def primary(self, arg: feather_tk._feather_tk.KeyShortcut, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def secondary(self) -> feather_tk._feather_tk.KeyShortcut:
        """The secondary shortcut; a key of Unknown is none."""

    @secondary.setter
    def secondary(self, arg: feather_tk._feather_tk.KeyShortcut, /) -> None: ...

    def __eq__(self, arg: Shortcut, /) -> bool: ...

    def __ne__(self, arg: Shortcut, /) -> bool: ...

class TimeUnitsModel(tlrender._tlrender.TimeUnitsModel):
    """Time units model."""
    def __init__(self, context: feather_tk._feather_tk.Context, settings: feather_tk._feather_tk.Settings) -> None:
        """Create a new model."""

    def save(self) -> None:
        """Save the settings."""

class ToolInfo:
    """Tool information."""
    def __init__(self) -> None: ...

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        """The tool's name, which its action and its menu item have too."""

    @name.setter
    def name(self, arg: str, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def icon(self) -> str:
        """The name of the tool's icon."""

    @icon.setter
    def icon(self, arg: str, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def sort(self) -> str:
        """What the Tools menu and the tools tool bar sort the tool by."""

    @sort.setter
    def sort(self, arg: str, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def toolBar(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the tool has a button on the tools tool bar."""

    @toolBar.setter
    def toolBar(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def shortcut(self) -> feather_tk._feather_tk.KeyShortcut:
        """The tool's default keyboard shortcut."""

    @shortcut.setter
    def shortcut(self, arg: feather_tk._feather_tk.KeyShortcut, /) -> None: ...

class ToolsModel:
    """Tools model."""
    def __init__(self, settings: feather_tk._feather_tk.Settings) -> None:
        """Create a new model."""

    def save(self) -> None:
        """Save the settings."""

    @property
    def tools(self) -> list[ToolInfo]:
        """Get the tools."""

    def addTool(self, tool: ToolInfo) -> None:
        """Add a tool."""

    @property
    def openTools(self) -> list[str]:
        """Get the open tools, in the order they are listed above rather than
        the order they were opened, so that opening one does not move the
        others around.
        """

    @property
    def observeOpenTools(self) -> feather_tk._feather_tk.IObservableStringList:
        """Observe the open tools."""

    def isToolOpen(self, name: str) -> bool:
        """Get whether a tool is open."""

    def setToolOpen(self, name: str, open: bool) -> None:
        """Open or close a tool."""

    def closeTools(self) -> None:
        """Close every tool."""

    def showSection(self, tool: str, section: str) -> None:
        """Open a tool and one of its sections."""

class AspectRatioOptions:
    """Aspect ratio options."""
    def __init__(self) -> None: ...

    @property
    def index(self) -> int:
        """The entry in use: zero is Default, the file's own aspect ratio, and
        the others are the custom entries.
        """

    @index.setter
    def index(self, arg: int, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def options(self) -> list[tlrender._tlrender.AspectRatioOptions]:
        """The entries: Default, which leaves the file's own aspect ratio, then
        the custom ones, which the View tool edits.
        """

    @options.setter
    def options(self, arg: Sequence[tlrender._tlrender.AspectRatioOptions], /) -> None: ...

    def __eq__(self, arg: AspectRatioOptions, /) -> bool: ...

    def __ne__(self, arg: AspectRatioOptions, /) -> bool: ...

class HUDItem(enum.Enum):
    """HUD items."""
    FileName = 0
    """The options map is serialized with the enumeration index as the key, so
    changing this order requires a new settings version.
    """

    Information = 1

    Cache = 2

    Time = 3

    ViewZoom = 4

    ColorPicker = 5

    Render = 6

    LUT = 7

def getHUDItemEnums() -> list[HUDItem]:
    """Get every value of HUDItem."""

class HUDPos(enum.Enum):
    """HUD positions."""
    TopLeft = 1

    TopRight = 2

    BottomLeft = 3

    BottomRight = 4

def getHUDPosEnums() -> list[HUDPos]:
    """Get every value of HUDPos."""

class HUDOptions:
    """HUD options."""
    def __init__(self) -> None: ...

    @property
    def enabled(self) -> bool:
        """Whether the HUD is shown: View > HUD / Information Display."""

    @enabled.setter
    def enabled(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def items(self) -> dict[HUDItem, HUDPos]:
        """The corner each item is shown in. An item that is not in the map, or
        is at None, is not shown.
        """

    @items.setter
    def items(self, arg: Mapping[HUDItem, HUDPos], /) -> None: ...

    def __eq__(self, arg: HUDOptions, /) -> bool: ...

    def __ne__(self, arg: HUDOptions, /) -> bool: ...

class ImageOptionsObserver:
    """Value observer."""
    def __init__(self, observable: IObservableImageOptions, callback: Callable[[feather_tk._feather_tk.ImageOptions], None], action: feather_tk._feather_tk.ObserverAction = feather_tk._feather_tk.ObserverAction.Trigger) -> None: ...

class IObservableImageOptions:
    """Base class for observable values."""
    def get(self) -> feather_tk._feather_tk.ImageOptions:
        """Get the value."""

    def getObserversCount(self) -> int:
        """Get the number of observers."""

class ObservableImageOptions(IObservableImageOptions):
    """Observable value."""
    def __init__(self, arg: feather_tk._feather_tk.ImageOptions, /) -> None: ...

    def setAlways(self, arg: feather_tk._feather_tk.ImageOptions, /) -> None:
        """Set the value."""

    def setIfChanged(self, arg: feather_tk._feather_tk.ImageOptions, /) -> bool:
        """Set the value only if it has changed."""

    def get(self) -> feather_tk._feather_tk.ImageOptions:
        """Get the value."""

class AspectRatioOptionsObserver:

class IObservableAspectRatioOptions:

        """Get the number of observers."""

    def setAlways(self, arg: AspectRatioOptions, /) -> None:

        """Get the value."""

class HUDOptionsObserver:

        """Get the number of observers."""

    def setAlways(self, arg: HUDOptions, /) -> None:
        """Set the value."""

    def get(self) -> HUDOptions:
        """Get the value."""

class ViewportModel:
    """Viewport model."""
    def __init__(self, context: feather_tk._feather_tk.Context, settings: feather_tk._feather_tk.Settings) -> None:
        """Create a new model."""

    def save(self) -> None:
        """Save the settings."""

    @property
    def imageOptions(self) -> feather_tk._feather_tk.ImageOptions:
        """Get the image options: the minify and magnify filters, the video
        levels and the alpha blend the picture is drawn with.
        """

    @imageOptions.setter
    def imageOptions(self, arg: feather_tk._feather_tk.ImageOptions, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeImageOptions(self) -> IObservableImageOptions:
        """Observe the image options."""

    @property
    def displayOptions(self) -> tlrender._tlrender.DisplayOptions:
        """Get the display options: the channels, the mirroring, the negative
        and the color adjustments.
        """

    @displayOptions.setter
    def displayOptions(self, arg: tlrender._tlrender.DisplayOptions, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeDisplayOptions(self) -> tlrender._tlrender.IObservableDisplayOptions:
        """Observe the display options."""

    @property
    def aspectRatioOptions(self) -> AspectRatioOptions:
        """Get the aspect ratio options."""

    @aspectRatioOptions.setter
    def aspectRatioOptions(self, arg: AspectRatioOptions, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeAspectRatioOptions(self) -> IObservableAspectRatioOptions:
        """Observe the aspect ratio options."""

    @property
    def backgroundOptions(self) -> tlrender._tlrender.BackgroundOptions:
        """Get the background options: what is drawn behind the picture, and
        the outline around it.
        """

    @backgroundOptions.setter
    def backgroundOptions(self, arg: tlrender._tlrender.BackgroundOptions, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeBackgroundOptions(self) -> tlrender._tlrender.IObservableBackgroundOptions:
        """Observe the background options."""

    @property
    def foregroundOptions(self) -> tlrender._tlrender.ForegroundOptions:
        """Get the foreground options: the grid, the center marker, the missing
        frame indicator, the clipping warning, the frame guide, the safe areas
        and the data window outline.
        """

    @foregroundOptions.setter
    def foregroundOptions(self, arg: tlrender._tlrender.ForegroundOptions, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeForegroundOptions(self) -> tlrender._tlrender.IObservableForegroundOptions:
        """Observe the foreground options."""

    @property
    def hudOptions(self) -> HUDOptions:
        """Get the HUD options."""

    @hudOptions.setter
    def hudOptions(self, arg: HUDOptions, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeHUDOptions(self) -> IObservableHUDOptions:
        """Observe the HUD options."""

    @property
    def hdrTransfer(self) -> tlrender._tlrender.HDR_EOTF:
        """Get what the picture is display encoded for, SDR by default."""

    @hdrTransfer.setter
    def hdrTransfer(self, arg: tlrender._tlrender.HDR_EOTF, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def hdrWhite(self) -> float:
        """Get the luminance the window's white stands for, in nits; 203 by
        default. It is used where the system does not say.
        """

    @hdrWhite.setter
    def hdrWhite(self, arg: float, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeHDRWhite(self) -> feather_tk._feather_tk.IObservableFloat:
        """Observe the luminance the window's white stands for."""

    @property
    def dither(self) -> bool:
        """Get whether the picture is dithered."""

    @dither.setter
    def dither(self, arg: bool, /) -> None: ...

    @property
    def observeDither(self) -> feather_tk._feather_tk.IObservableBool:
        """Observe whether the picture is dithered."""
